<p>The names below match the labels shown in the <strong>Theme</strong> menu. The underlying id stored in <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>preferences.json</span></span></code></span> under the <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>theme</span></span></code></span> field can differ — e.g. <em>Cadmium Light</em> → <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>light</span></span></code></span>, <em>Cadmium Dark</em> → <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>dark</span></span></code></span>, <em>Graphite Light</em> → <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>graphite</span></span></code></span>, <em>Ulysses Light</em> → <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>ulysses</span></span></code></span>. The full label↔id mapping lives in <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>src/main/menu/templates/theme.ts</span></span></code></span>.</p>

<h2 id="switching-themes">Switching Themes<a class="anchor" aria-hidden tabindex="-1" href="#switching-themes">#</a></h2>
<p>You can switch themes in several ways:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Menu</strong>: Go to <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>Theme</span></span></code></span> menu and select your preferred theme</li>
<li><strong>Preferences</strong>: Open <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>Preferences</span></span></code></span> → <span data-rehype-pretty-code-figure=""><code data-language="plaintext" data-theme="github-dark-dimmed github-light" class="inline"><span data-line=""><span>Theme</span></span></code></span> tab to preview and select themes</li>
<li><strong>Follow System</strong>: Enable "Follow System Theme" to automatically switch between light and dark themes based on your system settings</li>
</ol>

<h2 id="custom-themes">Custom Themes<a class="anchor" aria-hidden tabindex="-1" href="#custom-themes">#</a></h2>
<p>Custom theme support is planned for a future release. In the meantime, you can use the "Custom CSS" option in Preferences → Theme to override theme styles.</p>
<h2 id="theme-credits">Theme Credits<a class="anchor" aria-hidden tabindex="-1" href="#theme-credits">#</a></h2>
<p>Many of these themes are inspired by popular color schemes from the developer community:</p>
<ul>
<li><a href="https://github.com/catppuccin/catppuccin" class="link">Catppuccin</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/dracula/dracula-theme" class="link">Dracula</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/sainnhe/everforest" class="link">Everforest</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/morhetz/gruvbox" class="link">Gruvbox</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/nordtheme/nord" class="link">Nord</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/rose-pine/rose-pine-theme" class="link">Rosé Pine</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/altercation/solarized" class="link">Solarized</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/enkia/tokyo-night-vscode-theme" class="link">Tokyo Night</a> - MIT License</li>
<li><a href="https://github.com/Gogh-Co/Gogh" class="link">Gogh Themes</a> - MIT License (color palette reference)</li>
